residual_limitations: Previous Test-informed research choices and mixed-report exposure mean this is not blinded or independent confirmatory evidence.

Three-seed native endpoints, CPU sampled diagnostics and partly CPU full-row predictions have distinct provenance and numerical tolerance.
Entity-equal sample estimates describe represented sampled entities; they are not a full-entity census.
